purpose: Acceptance checks for grounded drafts, distinct from real human or assistant-labelled control data
cases: 19 synthetic cases: RU 8, KK 5, UZ 5, und 1
unit_tests: Separate checks require every quoted citation to exist in both the sent sources and the local knowledge index, exact allegation provenance, no escalation downgrade, no secret echo, provider wire schema and localhost HTTP/CLI integration
quality_limit: No external model calls or independent human linguistic evaluation; this does not establish live-model answer quality
